اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُحَطُّ الأَوْزَارُ.




121


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ مَنَازِلُ الأَبْرَارِ.




122


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ يُرْحَمُ الكِبَارُ وَالصِّغَارُ.




123


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ نَتَنَعَّمُ فِي هَذِهِ الدَّارِ وَفِي تِلْكَ الدَّارِ.




124


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ رَحْمَةُ العَزِيزِ الغَفَّارِ.




125


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَنْصُورِ المُؤَيَّدِ.




126


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُخْتَارِ المُمَجَّدِ.




127


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ.




128


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ إِذَا مَشَى فِي البَرِّ الأَقْفَرِ تَعَلَّقَتِ الوُحُوشُ بِأَذْيَالِهِ.




129


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.




130


الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى حِلْمِهِ بَعْدَ عِلْمِهِ، وَعَلَى عَفْوِهِ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِهِ.




131


اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الفَقْرِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ إِلَّا لَكَ، وَمِنَ الخَوْفِ إِلَّا مِنْكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ زُورًا، أَوْ أَغْشَى فُجُورًا، أَوْ أَكُونَ بِكَ مَغْرُورًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ، وَعُضَالِ الدَّاءِ، وَخَيْبَةِ الرَّجَاءِ، وَزَوَالِ النِّعْمَةِ، وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ.




132


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ حَبِيبُكَ (3)




133


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ خَلِيلُكَ (3)




134


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.




135


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.




136


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ.




137


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.




138


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَضْعَافَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.




139


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.




140


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى لَهُ.

title: Al-Laṭīfiyyah
text:
اَللَّطِيْفِيَّةُ


Recite once after Ṣalātul Isha. The Laṭīfiyyah is made 1000 times. It is built on Allāh’s Name al-Laṭīf, the Most Gentle and Subtle, who reaches the finest of matters and is kind to His servants in ways they do not perceive. Its opening Āyah promises that He gives provision to whom He wills. It is a dhikr cherished in the Shādhilī Ṭarīqah, recited in times of difficulty, illness and constriction, asking that Allāh’s Decree unfold upon us with gentleness. Its benefits are ease in hardship, the softening of what is decreed, and an opening in provision.



1


أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ


A-ʿŪDHU BILLĀHIS-SAMĪʿIL-ʿALĪMI MINASH-SHAYṬĀNIR RAJĪM


I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan the rejected one.




2


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




3


﴿ٱللهُ لَطِيفُ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ١٩﴾


ALLĀHU LAṬĪFUM BIʿIBĀDIHI YARZUQU MAN(Y) YASHĀ-U WA HUWAL QAWĪYUL ʿAZĪZ


Allāh is kind to His servants. He Gives sustenance to whom He pleases, and He is the All-Powerful, the All-Mighty.


Sūratush Shūrā, 42:19




4×1000


يَا لَطِيْفُ ، يَا لَطِيْف


YĀ LAṬĪFU YĀ LAṬĪF, YĀ LAṬĪFU YĀ LAṬĪF


O Most Kind and Gentle One …..




5


يَا لَطِيْفًا بِخَلْقِهِ يَا عَلِيْمًا بِخَلْقِهِ يَا خَبِيْرًا بِخَلْقِهِ
اُلْطُفْ بِنَا يَا لَطِيْفُ يَا عَلِيْمُ يَا خَبِيْرُ


YĀ LAṬĪFAM BI-KHALQIHI YĀ ʿALĪMAM BI-KHALQIHI YĀ KHABĪRAM BI-KHALQIH ULṬUF BINĀ YĀ LAṬĪFU YĀ ʿALĪMU YĀ KHABĪR


O Most Kind to Your creation, O All-Knowing of Your creation, O All-Aware of Your creation: Be Kind [and Gentle] to us, O Most Kind, O All-Knowing, O All-Aware One.




6×3


اَللهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لَطَفْتَ فِيْ خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الأَرْضِ وَ لَطَفْتَ بِا الْأَجِنَةِ فِيْ بُطُوْنِ أُمَّهَاتِهَا اُلْطُفْ بِنَا لُطْفًا يَلِيْقُ بِكَرَمِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ يَا الله


ALLĀHUMMA YĀ MAN LAṬAFTA FĪ KHALQIS-SAMĀWĀTI WAL ARḌI WA LAṬAFTA BIL-AJIN-NATI FĪ BUṬŪNI UMMAHĀTIHĀ ULṬUF BINĀ LUṬFAN YALĪQU BI KARAMIKA WA RAḤMATIKA YĀ ARḤAMAR-RĀḤIMĪN YĀ ALLĀH


O Allāh, You have shown Kindness in creating the Heavens and the earth, and Kindness to the unborn in the wombs of their mothers, show us Kindness befitting Your Generosity and Mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy — O Allāh.




7


اَللهُمَّ ىَا مَنْ جَعَلْتَ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنَ الْقُرُبَاتِ نَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِكُلِّ صَلاَةٍ صُلِّيَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّشْأَةِ إِلَى مَا لاَ نِهَايَةَ مِنَ الْكَمَالاَتِ


ALLĀHUMMA YĀ MAN JAʿALTAṢ-ṢALĀTA ʿALĀN NABĪYI-I MINAL QURUBĀTI NATAQARRABU ILAYKA BI-KULLI ṢALĀTIN ṢULLIYAT ʿALAYHI MIN AWWALIN-NASH-ATI ILĀ MĀ LĀ NIHĀYATA MINAL KAMĀLĀT


O Allāh, You who have made the blessings on the Prophet a means of closeness to You in worship, we draw near to You with every blessing upon him from the beginning of creation until never-ending perfections.




8×3


بِسْمِ اللِه مَا شَاءَ اللهُ لاَ يَسُوْقُ الْخَيْرَ إِلاَّ اللهُ
بِسْمِ اللِه مَا شَاءَ اللهُ لاَ يَصْرِفُ الْسُّوْءَ إِلاَّ اللهُ
بِسْمِ اللِه مَا شَاءَ اللهُ وَ مَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللهِ
بِسْمِ اللِه مَا شَاءَ اللهُ لاَ حِوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَةَ إِلاَ بِاللهِ


BISMILLĀHI MĀ SHĀ-ALLĀHU LĀ YASŪQUL KHAYRA ILLAL-LĀH.
BISMILLĀHI MĀ SHĀ-ALLĀHU LĀ YAṢRIFUS SŪ-A ILLAL-LĀH.
BISMILLĀHI MĀ SHĀ-ALLĀHU WA MĀ BIKUM MIN NIʿMATIN FA MINAL-LĀH.
BISMILLĀHI MĀ SHĀ-ALLĀHU LĀ ḤAWLA WA LĀ QUWWATA ILLA BIL-LĀH


In the Name of Allāh, whatever Allāh wills, no one brings good except Allāh; In the Name of Allāh, whatever Allāh wills, no one averts evil except Allāh; In the Name of Allāh, whatever Allāh wills, every blessing you have is from Allāh; In the Name of Allāh, whatever Allāh wills, there is no might and no power except through Allāh.




9


وَصلَّ اللهُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلى آلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَ سَلَّمْ


WA ṢAL-LALLĀHU ʿALĀ SAYYIDINĀ MUḤAMMADIN WA ʿALĀ ĀLIHI WA ṢAḤBIHĪ WA SALLAM


O Allāh! Bless our Master Muḥammad, and his Family and his Companions, and grant them peace.




10

Make Duʿāʾ for your Shaykh, his family, for yourself, your parents, your fellow Murids on this Path, and for all the Muslims. (Refer to Duʿāʾ after Dhikr to proceed.)

title: Al-Musabbaʿāt al-ʿAshr
text: المُسَبِّعَاتُ الْعَشَرُ

title: Al-Musabbaʿāt al-ʿAshr
text:
1. Recite Seven Times – Surah Al-Fatihah


1


أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ


A-ʿŪDHU BILLĀHI MINASH SHAYṬĀ-NIR RAJĪM


I seek refuge in Allāh from Shayṭān, the rejected one.




2


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ ۝١


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




3


ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٢


ALḤAMDU LIL-LĀHI RABBIL-ʿĀLAMĪN,


All Praise is for Allah, Lord of the Worlds.




4


ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝٣


AR-RAḤMĀ-NIR-RAḤĪM


Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




5


مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٤


MĀLIKI YAWMID-DĪN


Master of the Day of Judgement.




6


إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۝٥


IY-YĀKA NAʿBUDU WA IY-YĀKA NASTAʿĪN


You [alone] we worship; And You [alone] we ask for help.




7


ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝٦


IH-DINAṢ-ṢIRĀṬAL MUSTAQĪM


Guide us to the Straight Path.




8


صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ۝٧


ṢIRĀṬAL LADHĪNA ANʿAMTA ʿALAYHIM, GHAYRIL MAGH-ḌŪBI ʿALAYHIM WA LAD-ḌĀLLĪN


Not [the Path] of those who earn Your anger (wrath), Nor of those who go astray.




9


آمِيْن


AMĪN

title: Al-Musabbaʿāt al-ʿAshr
text:
2. Recite Seven Times – Surah An-Nās


1


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




2


قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝١


QUL AʿŪḎU BIRABBIN-NAS


Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,




3


مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٢


MALIKI ANNAS


The Sovereign of mankind,




4


إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٣


‘ILÂHIN-NÂS


The God of mankind,




5


مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ۝٤


MIN-SHARRIL WASWÂSIL-KHAN-NÂS


From the evil of the retreating whisperer




6


ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٥


ALLADHĪ YUWASWISU FĪ ṢUDŪRI AL-NĀS


Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind




7


مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ۝٦


MINA AL-JINNATI WA AL-NĀS


From among the jinn and mankind.”

title: Al-Musabbaʿāt al-ʿAshr
text:
3. Recite Seven Times – Surah Al-Falaq


1


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




2


قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ۝١


QUL AʿŪDHU BI-RABBIL-FALAQ


Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak




3


مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝٢


MIN SHARRI MĀ KHALAQ


From the evil of that which He created




4


وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝٣


WA MIN SHARRI GHĀSIQIN IDHĀ WAQAB


And from the evil of darkness when it settles




5


وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ۝٤


WA MIN SHARRIN-NAF-FĀTHĀTI FIL-ʿUQAD


And from the evil of the blowers in knots




6


وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ۝٥


WA MIN SHARRI ḤĀSIDIN IDHĀ ḤASAD


And from the evil of an envier when he envies.”

title: Al-Musabbaʿāt al-ʿAshr
text:
4. Recite Seven Times – Surah Al-ʾIkhlāṣ


1


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




2


قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝١


QUL HUWAL-LĀHU AḤAD


Say: He is Allāh, the One;




3


ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝٢


ALLĀHUṢ-ṢAMAD


Allāh, the Eternal, Absolute;




4


لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝٣


LAM YALID WA LAM YŪLAD


He begets not, nor is He begotten;




5


وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ۝٤


WA LAM YAKUL-LAHŪ KUFUWAN AḤAD


And there is none like unto Him.

title: Al-Musabbaʿāt al-ʿAshr
text:
5. Recite Seven Times – Surah Al-Kāfirūn


1


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




2


قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ ۝١


QUL YĀ AY-YUHAL-KĀFIRŪN


Say, “O disbelievers,




3


لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ ۝٢


LĀ AʿBUDU MĀ TAʿBUDŪN


I do not worship what you worship.




4


وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ ۝٣


WA LĀ ANTUM ʿĀBIDŪNA MĀ AʿBUD


Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.




5


وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ ۝٤


WA LĀ ANA ʿĀBIDUM MĀ ʿABAT-TUM


Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.




6


وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ ۝٥


WA LĀ ANTUM ʿĀBIDŪNA MĀ AʿBUD


Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.




7


لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ ۝٦


LAKUM DĪNUKUM WA LIYA DĪN


For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.”

title: Al-Musabbaʿāt al-ʿAshr
section: 6. Recite Seven Times – Ayatul Kursi (2:255) up to Ayah (2:257)
text:
6. Recite Seven Times – Ayatul Kursi (2:255) up to Ayah (2:257)


1


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




2


ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ


ALLĀHU LĀ ILĀHA ILLĀ HUWAL-ḤAYYUL-QAYYŪM


Allāh: there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.




3


لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ


LĀ TAʾKHUDHUHŪ SINATUW-WA LĀ NAWM


Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.




4


لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ


LAHŪ MĀ FIS-SAMĀWĀTI WA MĀ FIL-ARḌ


To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.




5


مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ


MAN DHAL-LADHĪ YASHFAʿU ʿINDAHŪ ILLĀ BI-IDHNIH


Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission?




6


يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ


YAʿLAMU MĀ BAYNA AYDĪHIM WA MĀ KHALFAHUM


He knows what is before them and what will be after them,




7


وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ


WA LĀ YUḤĪṬŪNA BI-SHAY-IM MIN ʿILMIHĪ ILLĀ BIMĀ SHĀʾ


And they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills.




8


وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ


WASIʿA KURSIY-YUHUS-SAMĀWĀTI WAL-ARḌ


His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth,




9


وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا


WA LĀ YAʾŪDUHŪ ḤIFẒUHUMĀ


And their preservation tires Him not.




10


وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ۝٢٥٥


WA HUWAL-ʿALIY-YUL-ʿAẒĪM


And He is the Most High, the Most Great.




11


لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ


LĀ IKRĀHA FID-DĪN


There is no compulsion in religion.




12


قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ


QAT-TABAY-YANAR-RUSHDU MINAL-GHAYY


The right course has become distinct from the wrong.




13


فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا


FA-MAY-YAKFUR BIṬ-ṬĀGHŪTI WA YUʾMIM-BILLĀHI FAQADIS-TAMSAKA BIL-ʿURWATIL-WUTHQĀ LAN-FIṢĀMA LAHĀ


So whoever disbelieves in false gods and believes in Allāh has grasped the most trustworthy handhold, which never breaks.




14


وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ ۝٢٥٦


WALLĀHU SAMĪʿUN ʿALĪM


And Allāh is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.




15


ٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ


ALLĀHU WALIY-YUL-LADHĪNA ĀMANŪ YUKHRIJUHUM MINAẒ-ẒULUMĀTI ILAN-NŪR


Allāh is the Protector of those who believe; He brings them out of the darkness into the light.




16


وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ


WAL-LADHĪNA KAFARŪ AWLIYĀʾUHUMUṬ-ṬĀGHŪTU YUKHRIJŪNAHUM MINAN-NŪRI ILAẒ-ẒULUMĀT


And those who disbelieve, their protectors are false gods; they take them out of the light into the darkness.




17


أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ ۝٢٥٧


ULĀʾIKA AṢḤĀBUN-NĀRI HUM FĪHĀ KHĀLIDŪN


Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide in it forever.

title: Aṣ-Ṣalātul Mashīshiyyah
text:
الصَّلَاةُ المَشِيشِيَّةُ


Recite once daily. It was composed by Mawlāy ʿAbd as-Salām ibn Mashīsh, the Quṭb of his age and the Shaykh of Imām Abul Ḥasan ash-Shādhilī. Through Imām ash-Shādhilī it passed into the Ṭarīqah, and it stands among the most treasured of its prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ. Its words describe the Prophet ﷺ as the secret from which the lights burst forth, and ask for true knowledge of him and to be drowned in the Ocean of Oneness. It is recited for love and gnosis of the Prophet ﷺ, and for the opening of the heart to the Divine Presence.



1


أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ


A-ʿŪDHU BILLĀHI MINASH SHAYṬĀ-NIR RAJĪM


I seek refuge in Allāh from Shayṭān, the rejected one.




2


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allah, The Universally Merciful, The Singularly Compassionate.




3


﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا﴾


IN-NALLĀHA WA MALĀ-IKATAHU YUṢALLŪNA ʿALAN-NABIY,
YĀ AY-YUHAL-LADHĪNA ĀMANŪ ṢALLŪ ʿALAYHI WA SAL-LIMŪ TASLĪMĀ


Verily, Allāh and His Angels send blessings on the Messenger of Allāh. O you who believe, invoke blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation.




4


اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مَنْ مِنْهُ انْشَقَّتِ الْأَسْرَارُ


ALLĀHUMMA ṢALLI ʿALĀ MAN MINHUN SHAQ-QATIL ASRĀR


O Allah shower Your blessings upon him from whom burst open the secrets,




5


وَانْفَلَقَتِ الْأَنْوَارُ


WAN FALAQATIL ANWĀR


from whom stream forth the lights,




6


وَفِيهِ ارْتَقَتِ الْحقَائِقُ


WA FĪHIR TAQATIL ḤAQĀ’IQ


and in whom rise up the realities,




7


وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عُلُومُ آدَمَ فَأَعْجَزَ الْخَلَائِقِ


WA TANAZ-ZALAT ʿULŪMU ĀDAMA FA AʿJAZAL KHALĀ’IQ


and upon whom descended the sciences of Adam, by which all creatures are made powerless




8


وَلَهُ تَضَاءَلَتِ الْفُهُومُ


WA LAHU TADĀ ’ALATIL FUHŪM


and blessings upon him before whom all understanding is diminished.




9


فَلَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ مِنَّا سَابِقٌ وَلَا لَاحِقٌ


FA LAM YUDRIK-HU MIN-NA SĀBIQUN WA LĀ LĀḤIQ


None of us totally comprehend him, whether in the past or the future.




10


فَرِيَاضُ الْمَلَكُوتِ بِزَهْرِ جَمَالِهِ مُونِقَةٌ


FA RIYĀḌUL MALAKŪTI BIZAHRI JAMĀLIHI MŪNIQAH


The gardens of the spiritual kingdom blossom ornately with the resplendence of his beauty,




11


وَحِيَاضُ الْجَبَرُوتِ بِفَيْضِ أَنْوَارِهِ مُتَدَفِّقَةٌ


WA ḤIYĀDUL JABARŪTI BIFAYḌI ANWĀRIHI MUTADAF-FIQAH


and the reservoirs of the World of Dominion overflow with the outpouring of his light.




12


وَلَا شَيْءَ إِلَّا وَهُوَ بِهِ مَنُوطٌ


WA LĀ SHAY’A ILLĀ WA HUWA BIHI MANŪṬ


There is nothing that is not connected to him,




13


إِذْ لَوْلَا الْوَاسِطَةُ لَذَهَبَ كَمَا قِيلَ الْمَوْسُوطُ


IDH LAWLAL WĀSIṬATU LA-DHAHABA KAMĀ QĪLAL MAWSŪṬ


because if there were no intercessor, everything to be interceded for would vanish, as it is said.




14


صَلَاةً تَلِيقُ بِكَ مِنْكَ إِلَيْهِ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ


ṢALĀTAN TALĪQU BIKA MINKA ILAYHI KAMĀ HUWA AHLUH


So bless him with a prayer that is worthy of You, from You, as befits his stature.




15


اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ سِرُّكَ الْجَامِعُ الدَّالُّ عَلَيْكَ


ALLĀHUMMA IN-NAHU SIRRUKAL JĀMIʿUD-DĀLU ʿALAYK


O Allah indeed he is Your all-encompassing secret that leads through You to You,




16


وَحِجَابُكَ الْأَعْظَمُ الْقَائِمُ لَكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ


WA ḤIJĀBUKAL AʿẒAMUL QĀ’IMU LAKA BAYNA YADAYK


and he is Your Supreme Veil raised before You, between Your Hands.




17


اَللَّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْنِي بِنَسَبِهِ


ALLĀHUMMA AL-ḤIQNI BI-NASABIH


O Allah include me among his descendants,




18


وَحَقِّقْنِي بِحَسَبِهِ


WA ḤAQ-QIQNĪ BI ḤASABIH


and confirm me through his account,




19


وَعَرِّفْنِي إِيَّاهُ مَعْرِفَةً أَسْلَمُ بِهَا مِنْ مَوَارِدِ الْجَهْلِ


WA ʿAR-RIFNĪ IYYĀHU MAʿRIFATAN ASLAMU BIHĀ MIN MAWĀRIDIL JAHL


and let me know him with a deep knowledge that keeps me safe from the wells of ignorance,




20


وَأَكْرَعُ بِهَا مِنْ مَوَارِدِ الْفَضْلِ


WA AKRAʿU BIHĀ MIN MAWĀRIDIL FAḌL


so that I might drink to fullness from the wells of excellence.




21


وَاحْمِلْنِي عَلىٰ سَبِيلِهِ إِلَىٰ حَضْرَتِكَ


WAḤMILNĪ ʿALĀ SABĪLIHI ILĀ ḤADRATIK


Carry me on his path to Your Presence




22


حَمْلًا مَحْفُوفًا بِنُصْرَتِكَ


ḤAMLAN MAḤFŪFAN BI-NUṢRATIK


encompassed by Your Victory,




23


وَاقْذِفْ بِي عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَأَدْمَغَهُ


WAQDHIF BĪ ʿALAL BĀṬILI FA-ADMAGHAH


and strike through me at the false so that I may destroy it.




24


وَزُجَّ بِي فِي بِحَارِ الْأَحَدِيَّةِ


WA ZUJ-JA BĪ FĪ BIḤĀRIL AḤADIY-YAH


Plunge me into the seas of Oneness,




25


وَانْشُلْنِي مِنْ أَوْحَالِ التَّوْحِيدِ


WANSHULNĪ MIN AWḤĀLIT-TAWḤĪD


pull me out of the morass of metaphorical Unity,




26


وَأَغْرِقْنِي فِي عَيْنِ بَحْرِ الْوَحْدَةِ


WA AGHRIQNĪ FĪ ʿAYNI BAḤRIL WAḤDAH


and drown me in the Essence of the Ocean of Unicity




27


حَتَّىٰ لَا أَرَىٰ وَلَا أَسْمَعَ وَلَا أَجِدَ وَلَا أُحِسَّ إِلَّا بِهَا


ḤATTĀ LĀ ARĀ WA LĀ ASMAʿA WA LĀ AJIDA WA LĀ UḤISSA ILLĀ BIHĀ


until I neither see, nor hear, nor find, nor sense, except through It.




28


وَاجْعَلِ الْحِجَابَ الْأَعْظَمَ حَيَاةَ رُوحِي


WAJʿALIL ḤIJĀBAL AʿA-ẒAMA ḤAYĀTA RŪḤI


O Allah make the Supreme Veil the life of my spirit




29


وَرُوحَهُ سِرَّ حَقِيقَتِي


WA RŪḤAHU SIRRA ḤAQĪQATĪ


and make his spirit the secret of my reality,




30


وَحَقِيقَتَهُ جَامِعَ عَوَالِمِي


WA ḤAQĪQATAHU JĀMIʿA ʿAWĀLIMĪ


and his soul the secret of my reality




31


بِتَحْقِيقِ الْحَقِّ الْأَوَّلِ


BITAḤQĪQIL ḤAQ-QIL AWWAL


and his reality the conflux of my worlds through the realization of the First Truth




32


يَا أَوَّلُ يَا آخِر


YĀ AWWALU YĀ ĀKHIR


O First! O Last!




33


يَا ظَاهِرُ يَا بَاطِن


YĀ ẒĀHIRU YĀ BĀṬIN


O Manifest! O Most Hidden!




34


اِسْمَعْ نِدآئِي بِمَا سَمِعْتَ بِهِ نِدَآءَ عَبْدِكَ زَكَرِيَّا


ISMʿA NIDĀ’I BIMĀ SAMIʿTA BIHI NIDĀ’A ʿABDIKA ZAKARIYYĀ


Hear my call as You heard the call of your servant Zakariya




35


وَانْصُرْنِي بِكَ لَكَ


WANṢURNI BIKA LAK


and grant me victory through You, for You




36


وَأَيِّدْنِي بِكَ لَكَ


WA AY-YIDNI BIKA LAK


and support me through You, for You




37


وَاجْمَعْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ


WAJMAʿ BAYNĪ WA BAYNAK


and join me to You




38


وَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ غَيْرِكَ


WA ḤUL BAYNĪ WA BAYNA GHAYRIK


and come between myself and anything other than You—




39


الله الله الله


ALLĀĀĀH ALLĀĀĀH ALLĀĀĀH


Allaaah! Allaaah! Allaaah!
[Hold each ĀĀĀ for twelve slow measures]




40


إِنَّ الَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لَرَادُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ


IN-NALLADHĪ FARAḌA ʿALAYKAL QUR’ĀNA LA-RĀD-DUKA ILĀ MAʿĀD


Indeed He, Who ordained the Qur’an for you, will return you to the station of your Ultimate Destiny.




41×3


﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا﴾


RABBANĀ ĀTINĀ MIN LADUNKA RAḤMATAN WA HAYYI’ LANĀ MIN AMRINĀ RASHADA


﴾O Lord grant us from Your Presence Mercy and endow us, whatever our outward condition, with sure Guidance!﴿




42


﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا﴾


IN-NALLĀHA WA MALĀ-IKATAHU YUṢALLŪNA ʿALAN-NABIY, YĀ AY-YUHAL-LADHĪNA ĀMANŪ ṢALLŪ ʿALAYHI WA SAL-LIMŪ TASLĪMĀ


﴾Verily, Allāh and His Angels send blessings on the Messenger of Allāh. O you who believe, invoke blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation.﴿




43


صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهُ وَتَحِيَّاتُهُ وَرَحَمَاتُهُ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ


ṢALAWĀTULLĀHI WA SALĀMUHU WA TAḤIYYĀTUHU WA RAḤAMĀTUHU WA BARAKĀTUHU ʿALĀ SAYYIDINĀ MUḤAMMAD




44


عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ


ʿABDIKA WA NABIYYIKA WA RASŪLIKAN-NABI-YIL-UMMIYYI WA ʿALĀ ĀLIHI WA ṢAḤBIHI WA SALLIM




45


عَدَدَ الشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ وَعَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِ رَبِّنَا التَّامَّاتِ الْمُبَارَكَاتِ


ʿADADASH-SHAFʿI WAL-WATRI WA ʿADADA KALIMĀTI RABBINAT-TĀMĀTIL MUBĀRAKĀT




46


سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ


SUBḤĀNA RABBIKA RABBIL ʿIZZATI ʿAMA YAṢIFŪN WA SALĀMUN ʿALAL-MURSALĪN




47


وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ


WAL-ḤAMDU LILLĀHI RABBIL ʿĀLAMĪN




48

Make Duʿāʾ for your Shaykh, his family, for yourself, your parents, your fellow Murids on this Path, and for all the Muslims. (Refer to Duʿāʾ after Dhikr to proceed.)

title: Aṣ-Ṣalātut Tāziyyah
text:
الصَّلَاةُ التَّازِيَّةُ


Recite 11 times after each Farḍ Ṣalāh, for a total of 55 times per day. It is named after Sayyidī Ibrāhīm at-Tāzī, a saint of the Maghrib, and is also known as aṣ-Ṣalātut Tafrījiyyah, the Ṣalāh of relief. It asks for blessings upon the one by whose virtue knots are untied, distress is lifted, needs are met and a good end is reached. The ʿUlamāʾ relate that it is recited in times of hardship, and many have found relief through it. Kept after every Ṣalāh, it joins the Murid’s whole day to the Prophet ﷺ.



1


أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ


A-ʿŪDHU BILLĀHI MINASH SHAYṬĀ-NIR RAJĪM


I seek refuge in Allāh from Shayṭān, the rejected one.




2


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




3


اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ صَلَاةً كَامِلَةً


ALLĀHUMMA ṢALLI ṢALĀTAN KĀMILATAN


O Allāh, send perfect blessings




4


وَسَلِّمْ سَلَامًا تَامًّا


WA SALLIM SALĀMAN TĀM-MAN


and complete peace,




5


عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ


ʿALĀ SAYYIDINĀ MUḤAMMADIN


upon our master Muḥammad.




6


اَلَّذِي تَنْحَلُّ بِهِ الْعُقَدُ


ALLA-DHĪ TAN-ḤALLU BIHIL ʿUQADU


By virtue of whom all obstacles are removed,




7


وَتَنْفَرِجُ بِهِ الْكُرَبُ


WA TAN-FARIJU BIHIL KURABU


Distress is relieved,




8


وَتُقْضَى بِهِ الْحَوَائِجُ


WA TUQ-ḌĀ BIHIL ḤAWĀ-IJU


Needs are met,




9


وَتُنَالُ بِهِ الرَّغَائِبُ وَحُسْنُ الْخَوَاتِيمِ


WA TUNĀLU BIHIR-RA-GHĀ-IBU, WA ḤUSNUL KHAWĀTĪM


Desires are fulfilled and a good end may be achieved,




10


وَيُسْتَسْقَى الْغَمَامُ بِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ


WA YUS-TAS-QAL-GHAMĀMU BI WAJ-HI-HIL KARĪM


And by virtue of whose noble face clouds may be sent,




11


وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ


WA ʿALĀ ĀLIHI WA ṢAHBIHI


And [send blessings and peace] upon his Family and Companions,




12


فِي كُلِّ لَمْحَةٍ وَنَفَسٍ


FĪ KULLI LAMḤATIN WA NAFASIN


With every movement of the eyes, and every breath,




13


بِعَدَدِ كُلِّ مَعْلُومٍ لَكَ


BI ʿADADI KULLI MAʿLŪMIN LAK


By the number of all things known to You.




14

Make Duʿāʾ for your Shaykh, his family, for yourself, your parents, your fellow Murids on this Path, and for all the Muslims. (Refer to Duʿāʾ after Dhikr to proceed.)

title: The Adab of Dhikr
text: آدَابُ الذِّكْرِ

title: The Adab of Dhikr
text:
How the Dhikr Is Recited
Allāh says, “Remember Me; I will remember you” (Sūratul Baqarah, 2:152), and “Verily, in the remembrance of Allāh do hearts find rest” (Sūratur Raʿd, 13:28). Recite each dhikr in the order it is given, from its first line to its last, keeping the number of times shown beside each line. Pronounce every word clearly and without hurry, giving each letter its right, for the words are those of the Qurʾān, the Prophet ﷺ and the people of Allāh. Let the tongue and the heart move together: read the meaning beside each line until it settles in the heart, so the dhikr is understood and not only said.

title: The Adab of Dhikr
text:
The Adab of Dhikr
Come to dhikr in a state of wuḍūʾ, in clean clothes and a clean place, wearing fragrance if you can. Face the Qiblah and sit with stillness and respect, as one sitting before his Lord. Before beginning, make a sincere intention to remember Allāh for His sake alone, and seek forgiveness for what came before. Keep the voice moderate, neither loud nor silent, and do not speak or turn to other matters until the dhikr is done. Leave the world at the door: the phone, the worries and the distractions. Above all, be constant, for the deeds most beloved to Allāh are those done consistently, even if they are few.

title: The Adab of Dhikr
text:
The Weekly Gathering
Once each week the dhikr is made together, in a gathering of the Murids. The Prophet ﷺ said, “No people sit remembering Allāh but that the angels surround them, mercy covers them, tranquillity descends upon them, and Allāh mentions them to those who are with Him.” The gathering strengthens the Murid, joins the hearts of the brothers and sisters on the Path, and carries the one who is weak with the strength of the group. Make every effort to attend, and to arrive before it begins.

title: The Adab of Dhikr
text:
Duʿāʾ after Every Dhikr
Every dhikr closes with duʿāʾ, for after remembrance the heart is soft and near. Make duʿāʾ for the Shaykh and his family, for yourself, your parents, your fellow Murids and all the Muslims. The outline of this duʿāʾ is given in the Duʿāʾ after Dhikr; follow it, and add your own needs to it.

title: The Adab of Dhikr
section: Following the Leader of the Gathering
text:
Following the Leader of the Gathering
In the gathering, the one leading the dhikr is followed in all of its procedure: when to begin and end, the order of the litanies, the pace, the voice and the number of each line. Recite with him and not ahead of him, and do not change or add to what is being recited. If anything is unclear, ask him after the gathering, not during it. Following the leader keeps the gathering as one voice and one heart, and it is part of the adab of the Path.

title: The Adab of Dhikr
text:
The Wirdul ʿĀm and Permission
The Wirdul ʿĀm is the base dhikr of every Murid of the Ṭarīqah. It is recited every morning and evening, and it is never left. The other awrād in this booklet are not taken up by one’s own choice. A Murid begins a dhikr only after receiving permission (idhn) for it from the Shaykh, who knows what each Murid is ready to carry. The Path is travelled through permission, and a litany taken with the Shaykh’s idhn carries the blessing of the chain that reaches back to the Prophet ﷺ.

title: Sūratul Fātiḥah
text:
سُورَةُ الْفَاتِحَةِ


Sūratul Fātiḥah is Ummul Kitāb, the Mother of the Book, and the Prophet ﷺ called it the greatest Sūrah in the Qurʾān. It is recited in every rakʿah of every Ṣalāh, and the gathering of dhikr opens with it. In seven Āyāt it holds the whole of the Dīn: praise of Allāh, His Lordship and Mercy, worship of Him alone, and the plea for guidance on the Straight Path. Allāh answers the servant after each Āyah, so the Murid recites it with presence, as one in conversation with his Lord. It is a cure and a protection, and a key to the opening of every affair.



1


أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ


A-ʿŪDHU BILLĀHI MINASH SHAYṬĀ-NIR RAJĪM


I seek refuge in Allāh from Shayṭān, the rejected one.




2


بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ ۝١


BIS-MIL-LĀHIR RAḤMĀ-NIR RAḤĪM


In the Name of Allāh, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




3


ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٢


ALḤAMDU LIL-LĀHI RABBIL-ʿĀLAMĪN


All praise is for Allāh, Lord of the Worlds.




4


ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝٣


AR-RAḤMĀ-NIR-RAḤĪM


Most Gracious, Most Merciful.




5


مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٤


MĀLIKI YAWMID-DĪN


Master of the Day of Judgement.




6


إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۝٥


IY-YĀKA NAʿBUDU WA IY-YĀKA NASTAʿĪN


You [alone] we worship; and You [alone] we ask for help.




7


ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝٦


IH-DINAṢ-ṢIRĀṬAL MUSTAQĪM


Guide us to the Straight Path.




8


صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ۝٧


ṢIRĀṬAL LADHĪNA ANʿAMTA ʿALAYHIM, GHAYRIL MAGH-ḌŪBI ʿALAYHIM WA LAD-ḌĀLLĪN


Not [the Path] of those who earn Your anger (wrath), nor of those who go astray.




9


آمِيْن


ĀMĪN
